title: When? interview grid
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: Dates and days of the week; my electronic games
source: Seeded from arabic/y5 lesson 16 (Pupil PDF worksheet: when? interview grid)
intro: Lesson 16: Asking when? مَتَى. To understand how to ask and answer 'when?' questions with days, months and times of day

questions.a: For example: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ فِي الصَّبَاحِ
questions.model: Teacher: take the verb from the question, change تَذْهَبُ (you go) to أَذْهَبُ (I go), and add when: فِي الصَّبَاحِ.

questions.q: Interview grid on the pupil PDF: ask a partner four مَتَى questions (read Qur'an, play, sleep, eat) in a breakout, write their answers in Arabic, then report one back.
questions.a: Four questions and answers, for example: يَنَامُ قَبْلَ السَّاعَةِ التَّاسِعَةِ or أَنَامُ بَعْدَ العِشَاءِ
questions.model: Teacher asks a pupil: مَتَى تَأْكُلُ الفَطُورَ؟ Pupil: آكُلُ الفَطُورَ فِي الصَّبَاحِ. Teacher writes it in the grid.

questions.q: ask مَتَى رَمَضَانُ؟ and answer with the month number.
use both قَبْلَ and بَعْدَ in one sentence.
questions.a: For example: أَتَوَضَّأُ قَبْلَ الصَّلَاةِ وَأَقْرَأُ بَعْدَهَا

questions.q: Back to our ponder: the most important 'when?'
questions.a: مَتَى الصَّلَاةُ؟ When is the salah?
